products.label: 01 / PRACTICE
products.name: Modaoshi / 磨刀石 A1 & A2
products.description: Practice decisions on 88 curated U.S. stock-history replays, one candle at a time. Choose Long, Short or Stay out, record risk and decision notes, and export or import a local JSON training archive.
products.audience: Independent learners who want deliberate historical stock-replay practice.
details: Historical simulation and education; no investment advice, stock recommendations, live market data or trade execution.
A1: $199 paid once for 12 months; no automatic renewal and no lifetime access. A2: $29 per month, renewing until cancelled.
After payment, use the purchase email and activation code at modaoshi.pages.dev/mds/en/login.

products.label: 02 / RISK CONTEXT
products.name: Traffic Light / 红绿灯 B1
products.description: A daily U.S. market risk signal describing participation, caution or defense. Green favors participation; yellow calls for tighter risk; red emphasizes defense.
products.audience: U.S. market participants looking for broad market risk context.
details: Broad U.S. market conditions, not buy or sell instructions for an individual stock.
Monthly Access is $19; Annual Access is $149. Confirm the selected access period and checkout terms before payment.
Historical backtests are not live results and do not predict future performance.

products.label: 03 / LIFE DECISIONS
products.name: Women's Decision Intelligence / 女性决策 WDI
products.os: Compatible AI agent; optional Python MCP adapter
products.description: A bilingual decision-support skill that examines resources, decision power, unpaid care, safety and reversibility. Includes research profiles, frameworks, playbooks and conditional action-card examples.
products.audience: People evaluating real-life choices under practical constraints, and AI-agent users who want structured decision support.
details: One-time $35 download: WDI customer release 2.4.3, 75 files, bilingual quick start and optional local stdio MCP adapter.
Includes 22 historical research profiles, 20 synthetic life-decision profiles and 20 bilingual card examples. These are not endorsements or a claim of 40 real users.
You retain the final decision. Jurisdiction-sensitive research cards require verification; AI client subscriptions are separate.

products.label: 04 / SEARCH READINESS
products.name: GEO / SEO Readiness MCP 2.1
products.description: Local software for public website audits, competitor gap comparisons, candidate remediation files and English or Chinese white-label PDF reports with auditable evidence.
products.audience: SEO consultants, agencies, technical marketers and growth engineers.
details: Four tools: audit website readiness, compare competitors, generate candidate patches, and export white-label PDF reports.
Solo $49 is a single-user license. Agency $129 covers your agency team. Both receive the same full source package.
Runs locally with installed dependencies and Chromium. AI client subscriptions, hosting and done-for-you consulting are separate. Readiness scores do not guarantee rankings or AI recommendations.
